source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full uniform lines mark boundaries between repeated panels.
    row_bounds = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_bounds = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(n, bounds):
        cuts = [-1] + bounds + [n]
        return [(cuts[i] + 1, cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cuts)-1) if cuts[i+1] > cuts[i]+1]
    rows = spans(h, row_bounds)
    cols = spans(w, col_bounds)
    panels = [(r0,r1,c0,c1) for r0,r1 in rows for c0,c1 in cols]
    # Use the panel with the most non-background cells as the pattern.
    def vals(box):
        r0,r1,c0,c1=box
        return [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
    candidate = max(panels, key=lambda b: len(set(vals(b))))
    r0,r1,c0,c1=candidate
    pattern=[row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for a,b,c,d in panels:
        for i in range(b-a):
            for j in range(d-c):
                out[a+i][c+j]=pattern[i][j]
    return out
'''

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    uniform = [row[0] for row in grid if len(set(row)) == 1]
    uniform += [grid[0][c] for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    divider = min(set(uniform), key=uniform.count)
    row_bounds = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == divider for x in row)]
    col_bounds = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    def spans(n, bounds):
        cuts = [-1] + bounds + [n]
        return [(cuts[i]+1,cuts[i+1]) for i in range(len(cuts)-1) if cuts[i+1] > cuts[i]+1]
    panels=[(a,b,c,d) for a,b in spans(h,row_bounds) for c,d in spans(w,col_bounds)]
    def values(box):
        a,b,c,d=box
        return {grid[rr][cc] for rr in range(a,b) for cc in range(c,d)}
    a,b,c,d=max(panels,key=lambda box:len(values(box)))
    pattern=[row[c:d] for row in grid[a:b]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels:
        for i in range(r1-r0):
            for j in range(c1-c0): out[r0+i][c0+j]=pattern[i][j]
    return out
